title: Birthday cake with candles with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Cake plate -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='40' ry='6' fill='#B0D8F0'/>
  <!-- Cake bottom layer -->
  <rect x='18' y='64' width='64' height='22' rx='4' fill='#F4A0B8'/>
  <!-- Cake bottom frosting stripe -->
  <rect x='18' y='64' width='64' height='6' rx='3' fill='#FFD1E0'/>
  <!-- Cake middle layer -->
  <rect x='24' y='48' width='52' height='18' rx='4' fill='#F4A0B8'/>
  <!-- Middle frosting -->
  <rect x='24' y='48' width='52' height='6' rx='3' fill='#FFD1E0'/>
  <!-- Cake top layer -->
  <rect x='30' y='34' width='40' height='16' rx='4' fill='#F4A0B8'/>
  <!-- Top frosting -->
  <rect x='30' y='34' width='40' height='6' rx='3' fill='#FFD1E0'/>
  <!-- Drip frosting on middle -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='48' r='3' fill='#FFD1E0'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='48' r='3' fill='#FFD1E0'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='48' r='3' fill='#FFD1E0'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='48' r='3' fill='#FFD1E0'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='48' r='3' fill='#FFD1E0'/>
  <!-- Drip frosting on bottom -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='64' r='3.5' fill='#FFD1E0'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='64' r='3.5' fill='#FFD1E0'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='64' r='3.5' fill='#FFD1E0'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='64' r='3.5' fill='#FFD1E0'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='64' r='3.5' fill='#FFD1E0'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='64' r='3.5' fill='#FFD1E0'/>
  
  <!-- Candles - left -->
  <rect x='36' y='20' width='4' height='14' rx='1' fill='#7AD8B0'/>
  <!-- Candle stripe -->
  <rect x='36' y='24' width='4' height='2' fill='#50C090'/>
  <rect x='36' y='29' width='4' height='2' fill='#50C090'/>
  <!-- Flame left -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='17' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#FFE060'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='18' rx='1.5' ry='3' fill='#FF9040'/>
  
  <!-- Candle - middle -->
  <rect x='48' y='18' width='4' height='16' rx='1' fill='#7AD8B0'/>
  <rect x='48' y='22' width='4' height='2' fill='#50C090'/>
  <rect x='48' y='28' width='4' height='2' fill='#50C090'/>
  <!-- Flame middle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='15' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#FFE060'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='16' rx='1.5' ry='3' fill='#FF9040'/>
  
  <!-- Candle - right -->
  <rect x='60' y='20' width='4' height='14' rx='1' fill='#7AD8B0'/>
  <rect x='60' y='24' width='4' height='2' fill='#50C090'/>
  <rect x='60' y='29' width='4' height='2' fill='#50C090'/>
  <!-- Flame right -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='17' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#FFE060'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='18' rx='1.5' ry='3' fill='#FF9040'/>
  
  <!-- Smiling face on cake top layer -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='2.5' fill='#6A2060'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='42' r='2.5' fill='#6A2060'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='41' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='41' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M43 47 Q50 53 57 47' stroke='#6A2060' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='46' r='2.5' fill='#FF8090' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='46' r='2.5' fill='#FF8090' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
